props.title: string
props.subtitle: string
props.stats: Array<{ label: string, value: string, change: number, trend: 'up'|'down', icon: 'activity'|'zap'|'shield'|'globe' }>

blocks.name: Mission Control Table
blocks.description: Interactive data table designed for resource monitoring and agent coordination. Includes status badges and search.

props.title: string
props.columns: Array<{ key: string, label: string, variant?: 'default'|'badge'|'currency'|'date' }>

blocks.name: Metric Grid
blocks.description: Responsive grid of high-density KPI cards. Supports custom icons and trend indicators.

props.metrics: Array<{ label: string, value: string|number, change?: number, trend?: 'up'|'down'|'neutral', iconName?: string, color?: string }>

blocks.name: Status Timeline
blocks.description: Sequential activity log with status indicators. Ideal for tracking mission progress, job logs, or history.

props.title: string
props.events: Array<{ id: string, timestamp: string, title: string, description?: string, status: 'completed'|'in_progress'|'failed'|'pending'|'info' }>

blocks.name: AI Agent Chat Interface
blocks.description: Premium conversational shell with streaming support, message history, and suggested prompt chips.

blocks.name: Platform Dataset Table (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: PREFERRED block for all CRUD apps. Full create/read/update/delete table wired directly to /api/oddjob/datasets. Includes search, pagination, create/edit modal (uses FormRenderer), delete confirmation. Zero fetch code required from the AI.

props.columns: Array<{ key: string, label: string, type?: 'text'|'badge'|'currency'|'date'|'number', badgeVariants?: Record<string,string> }>
props.title: string (optional)
props.searchableFields: string[] (optional — defaults to all column keys)
props.formSchema: FormSchema (optional — overrides auto-generated form with custom FormRenderer schema)

blocks.name: Platform Agent Chat (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: PREFERRED block for all chat/assistant apps. Streams responses from /api/oddjob/agents/{agentId}/chat via SSE. Loads conversation history from platform. Typing indicator, suggested prompts, error handling — all built in. Zero fetch or stream code required from the AI.

props.agentId: number — Oddjob agent ID to connect to
props.collectionName: string (optional — dataset collection for message persistence)

blocks.name: Platform Missions Table (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: PREFERRED block for mission management UIs. Fetches real mission runs from /api/oddjob/missions, polls for status updates, supports launch and abort actions. Replaces fake-data MissionControlTable.

props.title: string (optional)
props.onSelect: (missionId: number) => void (optional — called when row clicked, use to drive PlatformMissionLogBlock)

blocks.name: Platform Mission Log (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: Live scrolling log viewer for a mission run. Polls /api/oddjob/missions/{missionId}/logs, stops automatically when mission reaches terminal state. Pair with PlatformMissionsBlock onSelect to drive missionId.

props.missionId: number — run ID to stream logs for
props.title: string (optional)

blocks.name: Platform Pipeline Trigger (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: Loads available pipelines from /api/oddjob/pipelines, renders a picker, triggers execution via /api/oddjob/pipelines/{id}/execute, and polls execution status with step-by-step progress. Zero orchestration code required.

props.allowedPipelineIds: number[] (optional — filter to specific pipeline IDs)
props.title: string (optional)

blocks.name: Platform Dataset Chart (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: Visualizes dataset records using various chart types (line, bar, area, pie). Fetches data from /api/oddjob/datasets. Zero charting code required.

blocks.name: Platform Dynamic Form (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: Renders a full form from an Oddjob form schema. Handles validation and submission to /api/oddjob/forms/{formId}/submit. Zero form handling code required.

blocks.name: Platform Knowledge Graph Explorer (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: Interactive knowledge graph visualization with Cytoscape.js. Search, explore, and visualize entity relationships with force-directed layouts. Toggle between graph and list views. Zero graph query code required.

blocks.name: Platform Job Runner (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: Execute and monitor Oddjob jobs with real-time progress tracking. Select from available jobs, trigger runs, view execution history. Zero job orchestration code required.

blocks.name: Human-in-the-Loop Approval (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: Review and approve HIL requests from agents, pipelines, and automated systems. Shows request details, context, and approval actions. Zero approval workflow code required.

blocks.name: Platform Pipeline Status (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: Real-time pipeline execution monitoring with step-by-step progress visualization. Track active executions, view history, inspect step outputs. Zero pipeline monitoring code required.

blocks.name: Dead Letter Queue (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: View and manage failed jobs, pipelines, and missions in the dead letter queue. Inspect errors, retry failed items, bulk actions. Zero error handling code required.

blocks.name: Selenium Browser QA (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: Run real browser-based QA audits on forged apps. Tests page load, console errors, image integrity, responsive layout, and interactive elements. Real-time results via SSE.

blocks.name: App Version Control (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: Git-like version control for forged apps. View commit history, compare diffs, rollback to previous versions, create branches and tags. Full version management UI.

blocks.name: Multi-Agent Orchestration (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: Real-time monitoring and control for multi-agent AI architecture. View agent status, task queues, workflows, and performance metrics. Manage Architect, Coder, Reviewer, and Tester agents.

blocks.name: Blueprint Self-Evolution (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: Self-improving blueprints that learn from usage patterns. Track metrics, view evolution suggestions, manage blueprint generations, and approve improvements automatically generated by AI.

blocks.name: Platform Media Gallery (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: Image and video gallery with grid, carousel, and lightbox modes. Fetches media URLs from platform datasets with automatic thumbnail generation. Perfect for marketing sites, portfolios, and product galleries.

props.collection: string — dataset collection name containing media items
props.mediaField: string — field containing the media URL (image or video)
props.typeField: string (optional) — field indicating 'image' or 'video', auto-detected if not provided
props.columns: 1-6 (default 3) — number of columns in grid mode
props.lightbox: boolean (default true) — enable lightbox on click
props.title: string (optional) — gallery title

blocks.name: Platform Content Carousel (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: Testimonials, features, news, and quotes carousel. Multiple card templates with auto-play, ratings, avatars, and tags. Perfect for social proof, product features, and announcements.

props.items: Array<{ id, content, title?, author?, role?, company?, avatar?, rating?, tags?, cta? }> — supply items directly, bypassing the dataset fetch (use this in instant apps)
props.contentField: string — field containing the main content/text
props.avatarField: string (optional) — field for author avatar URL
props.title: string (optional) — block title
props.cardClassName: string (optional) — custom CSS class for cards

blocks.name: Platform Agent Swarm (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: Advanced AI block for coordinating multiple specialized agents on a single objective. Visualizes agent hierarchy, task delegation, and consensus-based outputs.

props.agentIds: number[] — list of agent IDs in the swarm
props.coordinatorPrompt: string — system prompt for the swarm leader

blocks.name: Natural Language Query (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: Conversational data explorer. Ask questions about your data in plain English and get instant answers with charts, tables, and insights. AI-powered natural language to SQL with automatic visualization.

props.contextDescription: string (optional) — description of the data context
props.title: string (default 'Ask Your Data')
props.placeholder: string (default 'Ask a question about your data...')
props.explainInsights: boolean (default true) — AI explains the insights

blocks.name: Knowledge-Driven Mission (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: AI-powered mission management with automatic context enrichment from knowledge graph and intelligent agent routing based on knowledge proximity. Visualizes mission context, agent assignments, and task routing decisions.

props.missionId: number — mission to visualize and manage
props.enableAutoEnrichment: boolean (default true) — auto-populate context from knowledge graph
props.enableAgentRouting: boolean (default true) — enable knowledge-driven task routing
props.showContextGraph: boolean (default true) — show knowledge context visualization
props.showRoutingVisualization: boolean (default true) — show agent routing UI

blocks.name: Spatial Signal Intelligence (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: Schematic signal panel: plots markers on a stylised radar backdrop with severity filtering and a detail popover. NOT a geographic map — marker positions are a linear offset from `center`, not a projection, and clamp at the panel edges. Reads /api/spatial/signals when that endpoint exists; renders labelled sample data otherwise.

props.title: string (default 'Spatial Signal Intelligence')
props.description: string (default 'Live Eulerian Hexagonal Telemetry & Field Operations')
props.center: { lat: number, lng: number } (default LA coords)

premium_features: Explicit sample-data state when no feed is connected

blocks.name: Hero Slider (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: Full-width hero carousel for marketing content. Auto-fetches slides from dataset with customizable CTAs, overlays, and text positioning. Perfect for landing pages and marketing sites.

props.slides: array — manual slide definitions (if no collection)
props.overlay: boolean (default true) — dark overlay on images

blocks.name: Image Comparison Slider (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: Interactive before/after image comparison with draggable slider. Perfect for showcasing transformations, renovations, edits, or any visual changes. Supports horizontal and vertical orientations.

props.beforeImage: string — before image URL (if no collection)
props.afterImage: string — after image URL (if no collection)

blocks.name: Video Gallery (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: Video collection player supporting YouTube, Vimeo, and direct URLs. Features grid/list layouts, pagination, thumbnail previews, and inline playback. Perfect for portfolios, tutorials, and media sites.

props.videos: array — manual video definitions (if no collection)

blocks.name: Social Media Feed (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: Aggregated social media feed displaying posts from Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, TikTok, or generic sources. Features platform filtering, engagement metrics, and auto-refresh.

blocks.name: Pricing Table (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: Dynamic pricing table with multiple tiers, billing toggle (monthly/yearly), feature comparison, and CTA buttons. Perfect for SaaS pricing pages with dataset-backed pricing data.

blocks.name: Testimonial Carousel (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: Customer testimonials carousel with quotes, ratings, avatars, and company info. Supports carousel, grid, or masonry layouts. Auto-fetches testimonials from dataset.

blocks.name: Stats Counter (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: Animated statistics counter with count-up animations, trend indicators, and multiple layout variants. Perfect for showcasing metrics, KPIs, and business growth.

blocks.name: Feature Grid (Self-Wiring)
blocks.description: Feature showcase grid with icons, descriptions, badges, and CTAs. Multiple layout variants including cards, compact list, and horizontal rows. Auto-fetches from dataset.
